# Working session: Market framing for board slides
Date: 2026-10-30 | Duration: 75m

## Summary
The discussion focused on creating a board-ready marketing narrative grounded in shipped capabilities, supported by visual market maps showing incumbents, entrants, and likely six-month positioning. Competitive analysis highlighted self-improving software, embedded AI agents, APIs, MCP, context aggregation, and broader product-development platforms, with competitors targeting marketing, engineering, product, and data audiences. Growth strategy priorities included targeted account-based marketing, segment-specific messaging, customer education, stronger post-sales enablement, Europe expansion, and improved Pro product-led growth. Self-hosting, data ownership, compliance, cost control, vendor consolidation, and scaling experimentation were identified as major buying drivers. Product priorities included developer experience, experimentation, feature flags, integrations, scalability, performance, and potential AI-focused capabilities. Marketing initiatives included case studies, webinars, public relations, targeted events, product-manager education, and new channels such as a newsletter. Launch timing was narrowed to Tuesday the 3rd rather than election day because of engagement and tone risks.

## Keywords
Competitive positioning, Self-improving software, AI agents, Product-led growth, Experimentation platforms, Vendor consolidation
